How Profit and MEV Are Verified

Profit = net asset change after observed costs
MEV criterion = transaction ordering or cross-pool mechanism
Trace all swap legs, principal, loan repayment, internal ETH and token transfers.Count gas and block-recipient payments once; pool fees are embedded in proceeds.Cross-pool arbitrage: at least two pools and capital / intermediate inventory closure.Sandwich structure: same operator's front trade, target trade and reverse back trade.Higher gas, proximity or one profitable leg alone does not prove MEV.Separate actual retained assets, market-reference margins and conditional target effects.372 historical front-removal experiments: 360 successful target comparisons; 12 target reverts.
